transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is that my eating has just been all over the place lately. Some weeks I barely even touch dinner, and then... other nights I'll just stand in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone else has gone to bed. It's just been really inconsistent.
When those nights happen, do you feel like you lose control and eat an unusually large amount of food?

Um, no, I wouldn't say I lose control. It's not like I'm eating a massive amount of food or anything like that. I just... I think I finally realize I'm hungry since I skipped dinner, so I'll just have a few handfuls of crackers or a couple of cookies. It's more just grazing, really. I stop when I'm not hungry anymore, it's just happening at a weird time of night.
After you eat those foods, do you ever make yourself vomit?

No, no I don't do that. I've never made myself throw up. Like I said, it's just a few crackers or whatever because I realize I'm hungry, so... I just eat them and go back to bed. I don't try to get rid of it afterward or anything.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight and become underweight?

No, I haven't lost a significant amount of weight, and I'm definitely not underweight. Like I said earlier, my eating has just been all over the place. Some weeks I barely touch dinner, and other nights I'm standing in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone's gone to bed. So, my weight really hasn't changed much because of how inconsistent it all is.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

No, I really don't. Like I was just saying, it's never a huge amount of food. I just kind of snack a little bit when I realize I'm hungry. I've never had a time where I just sit there and eat a ton of food all at once.
